data_size.description: Target size of input data blocks in bytes. Default is 16 MiB (16 * 1024 * 1024).

compression_level.description: Compression level from 0 to 9. 6 is the default.

out_slots.description: Number of 1 MiB output packets buffered.

exclude_patterns.description: List of shell patterns to exclude from the archive.

solid_mode.description: Solid compression mode. Valid values: no-solid, per_block, per_directory, solid, asolid.

preserve_permissions.description: Do not subtract the umask on extraction.

dereference_symlinks.description: Follow symlinks and archive the files they point to.
